hero.caption: Good views of the Three Brothers have slowly disappeared over time, due to rising treelines in the valley. This, however, is a lasting beauty found on the Valley Loop Trail. The Three Brothers keep its distinctive form by exfoliating slabs of granite along intersecting planes of joints. A few of Three Brothers's episodes of exfoliation have produced the largest rockslides in historical times. Yosemite National Park, California
